images.filename: Massed Pipe Bands Parade - Highland Games at Helmsdale Sutherland Scotland (6070812993).jpg
images.caption:
Crossing the New Bridge with the drum corps keeping the beat, while the pipers get their breath back!
Helmsdale Highland Games took place at Couper Park, Helmsdale on Saturday 20th August 2011. It is traditional that the Chieftain's parade is played to the field (on the south side of the River Helmsdale) from the centre of the village (which is on the north side of the river) by Pipe Bands. 
This year the Bands comprised:
- Northern Constabulary
- Royal Burgh of Tain
- Sutherland Schools
- Thurso
The Parade started from outrside the Bridge Hotel, along Dunrobin Street to the A9 trunk road (Stafford Street) and then southwards on the A9 over the Helmsdale (New) Bridge to Couper Park.

The weather was good, the crowd was in good form, and everybody seemed to have a great time.

images.filename: Armed Forces Day - Parade to Inverness Highland Games 2012 Scotland (Massed Pipe Bands) (7618399252).jpg
images.caption:
The Massed Bands play round the arena at Northern Meeting Park during the City of Inverness Highland Games.
As in several previous years, the Armed Forces Day and Parade was incorporated into the City of Inverness Highland Games.
Massed Pipe Bands formed up in Falcon Square and then proceeded to lead the Colours and parade from Eastgate through Inverness City Centre, to the Northern Meeting Park where the Highland Games was to take place. The Games then began with a Drumhead Service and Presentation of Veterans Medals.
The Massed Pipe Bands were under the command of Drum Major David Murray (BW, Ret) and comprised pipes and drums from:
- Northern Constabulary PB
- Inverness Royal British Legion PB
- Queens Own Highlanders Association PB
- Forres PB 
- Sutherland Caledonian PB
- Isle of Skye PB.

The weather was gorgeous for this memorable event, made all the more poignant by the absence of the man who organised the event these past few years (including this year), Pipe Major Denis Swanson of the Inverness Royal British Legion Pipe Band, who sadly passed away earlier this year.

images.filename: Northern Constabulary at Highland Games, Helmsdale Sutherland Scotland (6063996938).jpg
images.caption:
Sergeant Peter Allan, Brora, supervises Northern Constabulary Pipe Band as they tune up for Massed Bands.
The Annual Highland Games in Helmsdale is a big day in the local calendar, and this year the weather was kind. 

Northern Constabulary was, as always in attendance, especially for the parade from the village centre to the Games field at Couper Park - which entails regualting traffic on the main trunk road to allow the parade safe passage. Thereafter the local officers patrol the Games field and interact with the public in the best traditions of Scottish community policing.
